metadata.description: Pre-flight checks for apps built fast: find what will break you before you ship.

plugins.name: rls-audit
plugins.description: Audit a Supabase or Postgres app for access-control holes before it ships: tables with row level security off, policies that let everyone through, service role keys reachable from the browser, and paywalls enforced only in client code. Local files only - no network.

plugins.name: secret-sweep
plugins.description: Find credentials your project is leaking: API keys written into source, secrets in browser-exposed variables, env files tracked by git or sitting in its history, and keys baked into Dockerfiles or CI workflows. Never prints a secret in full. Local files only - no network.

plugins.name: token-screener
plugins.description: Screen your Claude Code token usage: where it went, which tasks and tools consumed it, and where it is avoidable. Local transcripts only - no network.

plugins.name: unit-economics
plugins.description: Work out what a D2C order actually earns after GST, product cost, packing, shipping, payment fees, COD returns and marketing: CM1/CM2/CM3, max CAC, breakeven ROAS and the discount floor.
